# VoxHearth 0.2.1

VoxHearth 0.2.1 adds reliable foreground Settings presentation and a guided
Accessibility recovery flow for replacing older builds. It retains both fully
local Parakeet Core ML speech models introduced in 0.2.0.

Download `VoxHearth-v0.2.1.dmg`, verify `SHA256SUMS`, open the disk image, and
drag VoxHearth to Applications. This official artifact is Developer ID signed,
notarized, and stapled by Apple.
